_note: Reference catalogue only. Active MCP servers are configured in the repo-root .mcp.json (which Claude Code loads) or via `claude mcp add`. The servers below are documented for when their backing service is deployed — copy the ones you need into .mcp.json.

context7.purpose: Live library docs (Spring Boot, Avro, Kafka, Testcontainers, Resilience4j).

github.purpose: Read PRs, issues, CI status. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN (repo scope).

postgres.purpose: Inspect live schema/indexes before writing migrations. Set POSTGRES_MCP_URL, then add to .mcp.json.

schema-registry.purpose: Query registered Avro schemas / check compatibility. Set SCHEMA_REGISTRY_MCP_URL.

jira.purpose: Read ticket descriptions / acceptance criteria. Set JIRA_MCP_URL + JIRA_TOKEN.
